claims.claim: 302TIL binds mutant pMHC more tightly in equilibrium SPR.
claims.location: Table 1; Figure 2b; Online Methods: Surface plasmon resonance
limitations: 25 C; Biacore T200; immobilized TCR; 1:1 steady-state fit; 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P-20; 5-10 microliter/min; 600-2000 RU. This is receptor binding, not peptide-HLA affinity.

claims.claim: The two peptide-HLA complexes have similar measured thermal melting temperatures.
claims.location: Figure 1a printed inset; Online Methods: Thermal stability
limitations: Prometheus NanoDSF backscatter; approximately 10 micromolar protein; 1 C/min; HEPES/NaCl/EDTA/P-20 buffer as E1; derivative scattering fits. Thermal stability is a proxy used by authors; no direct peptide-HLA KD or IC50 measured here. Printed labels, not trace digitization.

claims.claim: The paper interprets altered W6 geometry and receptor kinetics as pre-organization for 302TIL recognition.
limitations: Four static crystals establish conformations, not dynamic populations, transition rates, or mutation causality alone. Published dynamics are author analyses, not reproduced here. Ovarian HHAT case does not explain pancreatic vaccine outcomes.
